scope.geometry: All currently visible geometry and exact instance matrices; no photograph or replacement geometry

excluded.name: independently-authored-sky-only-environment
excluded.reason: Non-PBR shader has no automatic portable equivalent

excluded.name: real-reflected-garden-pond-ripple-surface
excluded.reason: Planar approximation replaced by physical surface reflection in path tracer

affinePreservation.parentMatrices: Retained as full source object matrices; all 2,185 source parent matrices are orthogonal/no shear.
affinePreservation.linkedLocalMatrices: Geometry Nodes Object Info + Instance on Points with TRS decomposition only for matrices with normalized column shear residual <= 1e-7; retained translations, rotations and scales.

worldCoordinateConversion: All source mesh objects, source lights, linked-instance parents and camera jointly rotated +90 degrees about X: Y-up to Z-up, no deformation.

skyRadianceProxy.source: Sky-only generated image; no reference-photo pixels and no architecture/garden content. sRGB decoded by Blender and used as 3D environment radiance.
skyRadianceProxy.orientation: Port of measured-sky.js yaw/pitch mapping with Blender Image Texture V-axis orientation accounted for; source glow longitude -90 degrees and latitude 3.6 degrees are aligned to exported analytic DirectionalLight direction.
skyRadianceProxy.lightPathSelection: Is Camera Ray=1 selects camera.40; other rays select environment.52. The earlier historical importer had these mix inputs reversed.

hemisphereLightApproximation.method: Shadowed environment radiance added only to non-camera rays

skyRadianceProxy.analyticSunDisk: Cycles world camera-ray disk aligned to source SUN_DIRECTION; full-bright angular core about 1.0 degree with a 1.2 degree soft support. The source-aligned directional sun supplies direct/indirect physical illumination; disk excluded from non-camera environment rays.

physicalWaterReplacement.material: Cycles Principled water with actual 1.333 IOR reflection, roughness 0.16, dark-green shallow-water body and subtle procedural micro-normal. Uses full scene geometry and generated sky as reflected radiance.
physicalWaterReplacement.nativeCustomShader: The Three.js planar ripple/reflection screen-space shader is renderer-specific and was not transplanted; this is a physical 3D surface approximation, not pixel equivalence.

physicalFoliageAdaptation.method: Principled opaque leaf/flower BSDF mixed with energy-conserving diffuse transmission:18%needle,28%broadleaf/petal. Uses actual sun/scene occlusion, not an emissive view-facing term.

materialAttributeParity.linkedInstances: ShaderNodeAttribute Instancer mode plus explicit point Store Named Attribute
materialAttributeParity.bakedShearAndDirect: Separate Geometry-domain material variants; direct source mesh instanceColor fallback is white, baked shear retains source RGB
materialAttributeParity.vertexColorMultiply: Kept only when the source vertexColors flag is true; instanceColors-only records do not also multiply sourceColor.

materialTransfer: Exported source PBR parameters/textures; original custom GLSL material hooks are not automatically portable. Original sky shader is represented by the authored sky-only radiance image plus source-aligned analytic Sun. Native planar water shader is replaced by a physical Cycles surface reflection.

lightCalibration.transfer: Scene01 source positions/colors; area*pi and point*4pi power conversion; direct SUN coupled to generated sky.
lightCalibration.worldGain: Current source132 sky uses3.5radiance gain,10% luminance mixing and[.97,1,1.08] channel gains; camera multiplier.40 and non-camera IBL.52 selected with correctly ordered Light Path inputs; source HemisphereLight.36 added to non-camera environment rays.
lightCalibration.nativeToneMap: Three ACESFilmic receives linear exposure multiplier 1.03; matching Cycles EV starting point is log2(1.03)=0.043 stops. AgX and ACESFilmic are different curves and are not pixel-equivalent.
